product.description: Monoprice™Full Motion TV Wall Mount Bracket for 40" to 90" TVs up to 132lbs, Max VESA 600x400The Monoprice Full Motion TV Wall Mount is purpose-built to accommodate TVs spanning 40 to 90 inches. With a robust weight capacity of 132 pounds, it's an excellent choice for medium to large displays. Unlike traditional fixed or tilt mounts that cater to a single viewing angle, this full-motion mount is ideal for spacious rooms with multiple viewing zones.When flush against the wall, the TV mount positions itself a mere 2.3 inches away, ensuring an unobtrusive appearance when not extended. Its full-motion extension capability spans up to 15.8 inches, allowing you to effortlessly pull the TV away from the wall and adjust its angle to suit various viewing areas—whether it's directing toward a kitchen table or minimizing glare from nearby windows.Beyond its full articulation capabilities, the Monoprice Full Motion TV Wall Mount offers an impressive 120-degree swivel range. You can also tilt the screen upward or downward for optimal viewing comfort, and the level rotation ensures your display remains perfectly horizontal. Whether you're relaxing on the couch, sitting on the floor, or standing in the kitchen, this wall mount provides the flexibility you need.To ensure compatibility with a wide range of TV models, the Monoprice Full Motion TV Wall Mount supports VESA mounting patterns from 150 x 100 up to 600 x 400. This broad range covers the majority of modern TVs. Plus, it comes with all the necessary mounting hardware, so you won't need to make any unnecessary trips to the local hardware store.In summary, the Monoprice Full Motion TV Wall Mount offers impressive flexibility for TVs ranging from 40 to 90 inches. Its sleek design, full-motion extension range, swivel capabilities, and compatibility with various TV models make it a reliable choice for creating the perfect viewing experience in any room.
